hadith:
Sales and Trade - Narrated `Abdullah ibn `Umar:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "He who buys foodstuff should not sell it till he is satisfied with the measure with which he has bought it.
message: Allah tests our faith through the opportunities and resources He places within our reach, calling us to act with integrity and fear of Him—whether in our dealings with others or in our personal conduct. By honoring our commitments, trading fairly, and recognizing that all benefits flow from Allah's mercy as Al-Naafi' (The Bestower of Benefits), we cultivate true consciousness of God and become among those who will be rewarded for their righteousness. Let us reflect on how we can embody honesty and gratitude in our daily lives, knowing that Allah sees all that we do.
name:
An Naafi’ - النَّافِعُ - The Bestower of Benefits

The name An Naafi' highlights the divine attribute of providing benefits and positive outcomes to the believers and all of creation. It emphasizes God's mercy and generosity, reflecting His role as a source of sustenance and care for humanity and the universe.
verse:
Al-Ma'idah - The Table Spread - 5:94

O believers! Allah will surely test you with game within the reach of your hands and spears to distinguish those who fear Him in secret. Whoever transgresses from now on will suffer a painful punishment.
